notes.title: The Sharing Update soft launch -- It's Live NOW
notes.content:
[b]The Sharing Update[/b] has been made available ahead of schedule for sharp-eyed bargain hunters.  Pick it up now while it's still cheap, because the price is going UP!  

[url=http://tunescapevr.com/release-notes/]Release Notes[/url]
This is a MAJOR update adding all kinds of functionality and warmth to Tunescape.  Share your creations, as well as download and view those created by others with the new browser menu.  

If you need help getting started, here's a 7-part tutorial series I put together to help answer questions you may have:
[url]https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ATiTbpkjaMU&list=PLZPDl2i4zxINU17M9ILGiLsppCij5jpKx[/url]

notes.title: Progress Report -- Big update coming soon!
notes.content:
The Sharing Update isn't far off!  I've put together a progress report over on the website, detailing everything that's being upgraded and added.  Obviously, the biggest addition will be the ability to share your Tunescapes and download others' creations to view (finally)!

[b][url=http://tunescapevr.com/2018/04/16/sharingupdate/]Progress Report: The Sharing Update[/url][/b]

Huge thanks to the early supporters of Tunescape, btw.  If you haven't picked up a copy yet, do it soon, because the [b]price will be going up with the release of The Sharing Update[/b]!

notes.title: Update 0.0.851 Live
notes.content:
The latest update brings another round of bug fixes and minor cosmetic adjustments, as well as Oculus Dash support.  But the bulk of the new content here is in the form of a demo Tunescape, which can be accessed from the Settings screen.  It should help give you a few ideas about where you can start on your own creations.

Full release notes, as always, can be found at [url]http://tunescapevr.com/release-notes/[/url]
